caption:
Delegates from @astana.hub  visited MStarsHub, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia to explore potential collaboration opportunities between the two organizations. The discussions centered around how Astana Hub and MStarsHub can join forces to make a positive impact on the startup ecosystem in the greater Central Asian region. 🤝🤝🇰🇿🇲🇳

Astana_hub serves as a regional epicentre for fostering innovative projects and cultivating groundbreaking IT companies. It aims to become a vibrant ecosystem that attracts a substantial number of talented IT professionals from around the globe. Its ultimate goal is to create an environment that nurtures the growth and success of the IT industry. 🚀🚀

MStars Hub, a leading startup accelerator in Mongolia, is dedicated to supporting early-stage technology startups in their expansion and global growth. With a comprehensive mentor-driven program spanning 5 months, MStars Hub facilitates a fast-track approach to guide startups through every stage of their journey. ✨✨
